title: Design System: Verónica Plodzien – Currículum Vitae

display.purpose: The candidate's name — the single h1. Navy, nowhere else on the page.

headline.purpose: Section titles (Experiencia, Educación, Informática, Contacto). Navy, always preceded by the terracotta hairline.

title.purpose: Entry headings: positions and degrees. Ink.

body.purpose: Profile, descriptions, institutions — all non-heading text. Paragraph text at 1.625 line-height, capped at 62–65ch.

label.purpose: Periods, levels, contact labels — tabular figures, +0.025em tracking, 500 weight.

shadows.name: arch-ambient
shadows.purpose: The page's only shadow: a diffuse Navy-Deep-tinted grounding under the arch portrait (large blur, heavy negative spread).

shadows.name: arch-ring
shadows.purpose: The page's only ring: a 1px ink hairline around the arch, keeping the photo from bleeding into the paper.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Easing for the hero entrance and all scroll reveals.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Easing for color state transitions (buttons, links), 200ms.

motion.name: hero-entrance
motion.purpose: The hero (photo, name, hairline, profile, actions) staggered entrance on load. Once only.

motion.name: reveal-in-view
motion.value: 550ms; opacity 0→1, y 16px→0; fires once (viewport margin -12% 0 -8% 0); stagger 60ms (timeline entries) / 80ms (section bodies)
motion.purpose: Sections fade up as they enter the view, exactly once.

motion.name: spine-draw
motion.value: spring (stiffness 60, damping 25) on scaleY 0→1, driven by scroll progress of the timeline (offset start 0.85 → end 0.5)
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: the navy timeline spine draws itself over the quiet ink guide as the story scrolls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all of the above disabled: reveals resolve to a static visible state, the spine ships fully drawn, smooth scrolling is off
motion.purpose: Hard floor under prefers-reduced-motion: content is always visible by default; motion never hides it.

components.name: Primary Action (Llamar)
components.description: The filled navy pill — the first and strongest of the hero's four actions; darkens to Navy Deep on hover.
components.css: .ds-act-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background-color: var(--navy); color: var(--paper); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-act-primary:hover { background-color: var(--navy-deep); } .ds-act-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--navy); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action (WhatsApp / Escribir un mail)
components.description: Outlined pill: 1px border at 30% navy, navy text; hover — solid navy border plus a 5% navy wash.
components.css: .ds-act-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--navy) 30%, transparent); background-color: transparent; color: var(--navy); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-act-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--navy); background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--navy) 5%, transparent); } .ds-act-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--navy); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Action (Descargar CV (PDF))
components.description: Borderless, unfilled Ink-Soft text action; the quietest of the four — it warms to navy on hover.
components.css: .ds-act-text { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background-color: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-act-text:hover { color: var(--navy); } .ds-act-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--navy); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: The section marker is a 32px × 1px terracotta hairline above the Fraunces navy headline — the only marker the page uses.
components.css: .ds-head-kicker { display: block; width: 32px; height: 1px; margin: 0 0 16px; background-color: var(--terracotta); } .ds-head-title { margin: 0; font-family: "Fraunces", "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--navy); }

components.name: Timeline Entry
components.description: A 14px dot centered on the 1px spine (7px from the edge, text 32px in). The quiet ink-15% guide is always present; the navy spine draws itself over it on scroll (the current dot is filled terracotta, past dots are paper-filled with a 1px navy-40% ring). The static capture below shows the undrawn state.

components.css: .ds-tl { position: relative; padding-left: 32px; } .ds-tl-spine { position: absolute; left: 7px; top: 4px; bottom: 8px; width: 1px; background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 15%, transparent); } .ds-tl-spine--drawn { background-color: var(--navy); } .ds-tl-dot { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 4px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-tl-dot--now { background-color: var(--terracotta); } .ds-tl-dot--past { background-color: var(--paper); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--navy) 40%, transparent); } .ds-tl-period { margin: 0; font-family: "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.43; letter-spacing: 0.025em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-tl-title { margin: 6px 0 0; font-family: "Fraunces", "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--ink); } .ds-tl-company { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--navy); } .ds-tl-desc { margin: 12px 0 0; max-width: 62ch; font-family: "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--ink-soft); }

components.name: List Row (skills / education)
components.description: Plain rows on 1px ink-10% hairlines (never on the first row). The skills variant is a baseline-aligned name/level pair across the column.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 14px 0; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 10%, transparent); } .ds-row-name { font-family: "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink); } .ds-row-level { font-family: "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.43; color: var(--ink-soft); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Contact Link
components.description: Navy underlined link, 3px underline offset, underline at 25% ink; the underline — not the text — tints to terracotta on hover.
components.css: .ds-link { font-family: "DM Sans", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--navy); text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 25%, transparent); text-underline-offset: 3px; transition: text-decoration-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--terracotta); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--navy); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Photo Arch
components.description: The one motif and the only framed object: top corners at 999px, bottom at 16px, a 1px ink-10% ring, and the page's only shadow (176px wide on mobile, ≤272px on the desktop column). The flat fill stands in for the portrait.
components.css: .ds-arch { width: 176px; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 999px 999px 16px 16px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 10%, transparent), 0 18px 40px -22px rgba(20, 38, 63, 0.45); } .ds-arch-img { aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; background-color: #e9e2d6; }

narrative.overview:
A quiet, warm, editorial dossier on cream paper. The page is one reading column and nothing else: it opens with the person — the portrait in its soft arch, the name in large Fraunces, a short profile, four ways to act — and then tells the career as a single drawn timeline, followed by education, a plain skills list, and contact. There are no cards, no boxes, no second background, and no icons; hierarchy is carried by type scale, hairlines, and generous whitespace. It is a document that looks typeset, not built.

The color discipline is the point: one strong color (deep navy) carries the identity, and a single warm accent (terracotta) appears only at the scale of hairlines, dots, and low-alpha tints. Motion is quiet and once-only — a staggered hero entrance, fade-up reveals as sections enter the view, and one authored moment: the timeline spine that draws itself as the story scrolls. Under prefers-reduced-motion everything becomes static and fully visible, which is a hard rule of the system, not an afterthought.
keyCharacteristics: One reading column (max-width 42rem) on cream paper; section rhythm 64–96px, 32px between heading and body.
One framed object on the whole page: the arch portrait — echoed by the favicon, nowhere else.
Fraunces only for the name, section titles, and entry headings; DM Sans for everything else.
Terracotta strictly at decorative scale: 1px hairlines, the 14px "now" dot, low-alpha underline and selection tints.
Flat by default: exactly one soft diffuse shadow and one 1px ring, both under the arch.
One authored motion (the self-drawing spine); all other motion is once-only fade-up.

rules.name: The One Strong Color Rule
rules.body: Navy is the only strong hue on the page. Cream and the two inks carry the document; navy carries identity.

rules.name: The Decorative Scale Rule
rules.body: Terracotta lives only at the scale of hairline, dot, and low-alpha tint. Its rarity is the point; the moment it fills a surface or typesets text, it stops being an accent.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is allowed on exactly three roles: the name, the section titles, and the entry headings. Every other character on the page is DM Sans — Inter is banned by the product.

rules.name: The Tabular Periods Rule
rules.body: Every period and date is set with tabular figures and +0.025em tracking, so the years of the timeline align vertically like a typeset table.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat and never cast shadows. The only shadow in the system is the one under the arch.

rules.name: The One Frame Rule
rules.body: The arch is the only framed object on the page (ring + shadow). Everything else — every list, every section, every action — sits unframed on the paper. The favicon (a 64px tile with 14px rounded corners) echoes the frame: navy arch, terracotta dot, cream ground.

dos: Do ground every surface in Cream Paper (#faf7f2); the page has no second background.
Do set hierarchy with type scale and whitespace — 32px from heading to body, 64–96px between sections, hairlines between rows.
Do mark every section with the 32px terracotta hairline above its heading, and the 64px one under the name.
Do keep the page a single reading column (max-width 42rem, centered); the only two-column surface is the hero at md.
Do type every period, date, and year with tabular figures and +0.025em tracking.
Do divide list rows with 1px hairlines at 10% ink, never on the first row.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion as a hard floor: reveals resolve to a static visible state, the spine is pre-drawn, smooth scrolling is off — content is never hidden by motion.
Do keep terracotta at the scale of marks: 1px hairlines, 14px dots, tints at 24% alpha or below.
donts: Don't add cards, boxes, or panels — no surface is framed except the arch.
Don't add shadows; the arch's diffuse one is the system's only shadow (and its 1px ring the only ring).
Don't let terracotta type, fill, or border anything; its role is mark, not color.
Don't introduce a second accent color, gradients, or decorative icon or glyph systems — the page carries no icons at all.
Don't set small-caps or uppercase eyebrow text above section headings; the hairline is the marker.
Don't set the name anywhere but the single h1, or set Fraunces on any text that is not the name, a section title, or an entry heading.
